ITEM 1 | Square white plate, about 26 cm across, used as the scale reference; food sits in its left-center area. | 0
ITEM 2 | Pale green leafy vegetable pieces with thick white-green stems, lightly wilted, glossy surface, two larger wedge pieces about 6-7 cm long on the left side of the plate, with a few smaller dark-green leaves beside them. | 45
ITEM 3 | Dark, charred-looking fillet-like piece with blistered, crisp-looking skin in dark olive and black tones, about 9 cm long and 5-6 cm wide, covering roughly 15% of the plate, with a glossy, slightly oily sheen. | 90
ITEM 4 | Flaky, pale off-white cooked flesh, moist and slightly separated into layers, about 4 cm by 3 cm, sitting beside and partly under the dark skin piece in the center of the plate. | 35
ITEM 5 | Scattered small golden-tan granules, roughly 0.5 cm each, dry and firm, sprinkled over the fish in the center, with a few reddish flecks; covers a small area of about 3 cm by 4 cm. | 5
ITEM 6 | Glossy dark brown-green sauce or liquid film, thin and sheeny, pooled lightly around the fish and vegetables, with small droplets visible on the plate surface. | 10
